text: こおり　ポケモン　つかわせたら　みぎに　でる　ものは　いないわ　あいてを　こおらせるって　とっても　きょうりょくよ！

structure.jp: こおり　ポケモン　つかわせたら
structure.en: when it comes to using Ice Pokémon

structure.jp: みぎに　でる　ものは　いないわ
structure.en: there is no one who can top me

structure.jp: あいてを　こおらせるって
とっても　きょうりょくよ！

patterns.name: 〜させたら
patterns.explanation: The 'let someone do' form plus たら means 'if you let that person do it', a set way to say what someone is best at. こおり　ポケモン　つかわせたら = 'if you let me use Ice Pokémon'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: みぎに　でる　もの
patterns.explanation: The phrase before もの tells you what kind of person is meant. みぎに　でる　もの = 'a person who comes out ahead', so with いない 'nobody is better'.

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って here is a casual way to bring something up as the thing you are talking about. あいてを　こおらせるって = 'freezing the opponent, well, that'.
